name: MakerWorld
author: David Reed
description: Desktop notifications for MakerWorld (Bambu Lab) account activity: new comments and replies, likes, new followers, system messages, and point-balance increases on your models. A headless service polls the Bambu Cloud account API on an interval and raises an omarchy notification for anything new; clicking it opens the model page. Unofficial - it uses the same endpoints the Bambu Handy app does, so you sign in once with the bundled makerworld-login helper. This first release is notifications only; a bar pill with the point balance and unread count is planned next.
